environment: Isolated local Supabase: native PostgreSQL, GoTrue, PostgREST, Storage and actual Next.js application; eight distinct managed identities; no hosted tenant claims.
browserTiming: Signed-in navigation through the first visible enabled task. DOMContentLoaded and native visibility wait avoid unrelated load-event and coarse expect polling delay. Earlier retained runs used page load plus expect polling; timing protocols differ, so do not infer a direct percentage reduction.
limits: Loopback networking, bounded bursts and synthetic records. Not a hosted capacity, long-duration stress, device accessibility or production SLA result.
